rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday equivalent for a general recent-time reference.

example.english: I have recently been unable to sleep well.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 fan3 m4 hou2

rows.note: Use this for an ongoing recent stretch around now, especially in the sense of “these days” or “lately.”

example.english: I have been very busy recently.
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 ngo5 dou1 hou2 mong4

rows.note: Use this for something that happened only a very short while ago, such as just now or very recently.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sik6 jyun4 faan6
